Terms of use and privacy notice
Grace Ride (恩典同行) is a private ride-coordination app for PJ State CMC. It is not a public taxi or e-hailing service. You must opt in yourself. The box is never ticked for you.

The app helps invited members arrange rides to church activities. An admin sends a link. You enter your own name and email. An admin later assigns your role and group. Until that approval, you can use your profile and nothing else.
Use the app only with a link that was sent to you. Do not share your invite link or passkey. One person, one account. A parent or guardian must opt in for anyone under 18.
Who is responsible for your data
PJ State CMC decides how this app uses your personal data and is responsible for it. Send any question, request or complaint about your data to the church office or to an admin in the app.

Your name, email and phone, and a photo or avatar you add. Saved pickup addresses (and optional map pins), ride times, event sign-ups and check-ins, and trip chat messages. For volunteer drivers: vehicle details (model, colour, plate), spare seats and service areas. If you book for family or cell members (proxy riders): their name, phone, pickup address and optional assistance notes — only add them with their permission. If you claim or share costs: payee details and receipt or transfer photos. Your notification preferences, plus sign-in and change logs for security.

Using this app shows that you take part in a church, and a ride may note a wheelchair, oxygen or other assistance need. The law treats religious belief and health as sensitive. By opting in you give your explicit consent for us to use this only to arrange your rides. Leave the assistance field empty if you prefer.

To identify you, approve your membership, match riders with drivers, contact you about a ride you are part of, share costs fairly, keep the app secure, and report attendance and transport to church leaders. We do not sell your data or use it for advertising.

A pickup address and area are shown to the assigned driver and the transport team once a ride is arranged. You may optionally tap “Use my current location” when saving a pickup address to attach a one-time GPS map pin for driver routing. Live location is shared strictly during an active, in-progress journey: drivers may share live GPS so passengers on that trip can see arrival times (on Android, via a visible foreground location service with an ongoing notification that never tracks in the background outside an active trip and stops automatically when the trip ends, is cancelled, or your session locks or signs out); passengers may optionally share a waiting-spot pin while the driver is on the way, which is deleted once picked up. All live driver and passenger coordinates are deleted as soon as the trip ends.

There is no public member directory. A driver or passenger sees a phone number only for a ride they share, after that ride is approved. If you create and share an optional Care Link for a ride, anyone with that link can view that trip’s status, driver/vehicle summary and live driver location/ETA only while the trip is active, until you revoke it or the trip ends. Admins, the transport team and the finance team see only the records they need for their work.

To find addresses, estimate arrival times and plan pickup order, the app sends addresses and map coordinates (never your name) to free OpenStreetMap services: Nominatim, OSRM and Photon. Your device may also load map tiles from OpenStreetMap. These servers may be outside Malaysia. Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors. When you tap Navigate or Open in Maps, the destination address or coordinates are handed off to your chosen external maps app (such as Google Maps, Waze or your device’s default maps app), which is governed by that provider’s own terms and privacy policy.

Sign-in, invite and account recovery pages may use Cloudflare Turnstile to block automated abuse; Cloudflare processes technical browser/device signals under its privacy policy and may operate outside Malaysia. If you opt in to alerts: web push notifications travel through your browser’s push provider (such as Google FCM, Apple, Mozilla, Microsoft or Samsung); on the web app you may also opt in to Telegram bot alerts (for alert messages only, never location) or WhatsApp/church alert webhooks when enabled by the church office. The Android app uses real-time event streams, periodic background notification sync, local encrypted/offline cache and home-screen widget snapshots on your device (all cleared on sign-out). Passkey sign-in uses WebAuthn / Android Credential Manager (biometrics stay on your device). Optional Android QR check-in scanning uses Google Play Services Code Scanner (manual code entry is always available). Optional calendar exports, private calendar feeds (.ics), phone dialling and share links open only when you choose them.

Live location: until the trip ends (or until picked up for a passenger waiting pin). Geocoded address cache: up to 30 days (1 day for failed lookups). Alert delivery logs: 30 days. Unreferenced uploads: 24 hours. Trip chats: 180 days by default. Read notifications: 90 days; unread: one year. Security logs: two years by default. Backups: 30 days. Your profile, saved addresses, vehicles and ride history are kept while your account is open and for as long as church records require after it is closed.

You can update your profile at any time. You can ask to see a copy of your data, correct it, receive it in a common format, or close your account. You can withdraw your consent, but you then cannot use the app. If you are not satisfied, you may complain to the Personal Data Protection Commissioner (JPDP).

Drivers are volunteers using their own cars. They must hold a valid licence, road tax and insurance, and drive safely. Riders pay no fare; any cost sharing only covers fuel and tolls at rates the church sets. Wear a seat belt and follow the driver’s safety directions. The church arranges rides in good faith but cannot guarantee any ride.

Use other members’ details only to arrange the ride you share. Do not copy, share or misuse them. Be respectful in chats. Do not upload anything unlawful or anything you have no right to share. Admins may suspend an account that breaks these terms.

The Grace Ride software and its design are protected by copyright and licensed to PJ State CMC. Do not copy, modify or redistribute them. The church’s name and logo belong to the church. Photos and messages you add stay yours; you allow the church to show them in the app for its ride work.
